import cv2, numpy as np
from PIL import Image
src=cv2.imread('first_frame.png')
hsv=cv2.cvtColor(src,cv2.COLOR_BGR2HSV)
# card bright, low saturation in known area
card=np.zeros(src.shape[:2],np.uint8)
poly=np.array([[568,255],[914,235],[960,559],[612,638],[503,548]],np.int32)
cv2.fillPoly(card,[poly],255)
# refine: keep brightish pixels
bright=((hsv[:,:,2]>90)&(hsv[:,:,1]<80)).astype(np.uint8)*255
# fill polygon, but remove tool via threshold
card=card & bright
# close small holes
card=cv2.morphologyEx(card,cv2.MORPH_CLOSE,np.ones((5,5),np.uint8))
out=src.copy(); out[card>0]=(out[card>0]*0.45+np.array([20,20,240])*0.55).astype(np.uint8)
cv2.imwrite('.tmp/cardmask.png',out)
# tool mask
tool=np.zeros(src.shape[:2],np.uint8)
poly2=np.array([[566,0],[603,0],[615,225],[611,320],[594,430],[548,452],[509,452],[488,424],[490,396],[507,374],[518,334],[535,292],[556,255],[572,222]],np.int32)
cv2.fillPoly(tool,[poly2],255)
# include dark/saturated pixels in polygon
dark=((hsv[:,:,2]<115)|((hsv[:,:,1]>80)&(hsv[:,:,2]<180))).astype(np.uint8)*255
tool=tool & dark
tool=cv2.morphologyEx(tool,cv2.MORPH_CLOSE,np.ones((5,5),np.uint8))
out=src.copy(); out[tool>0]=(out[tool>0]*0.4+np.array([20,240,20])*0.6).astype(np.uint8)
cv2.imwrite('.tmp/toolmask.png',out)
# inpaint both
mask=cv2.bitwise_or(card,tool)
mask=cv2.dilate(mask,np.ones((5,5),np.uint8),iterations=1)
bg=cv2.inpaint(src,mask,7,cv2.INPAINT_TELEA)
cv2.imwrite('.tmp/bg.png',bg)
print('areas',np.count_nonzero(card),np.count_nonzero(tool))
PY"
